description: Use to compare a current wheel (and tire) with a new one: how far the outer edge pokes toward the fender and the inner edge toward the suspension, the diameter and ride-height change, speedometer effect, backspacing, and whether the new tire width suits the new rim width. With measured clearances (outer: tire edge to fender lip; inner: to the nearest suspension part, both on the current setup) it returns fits / tight / rub. Leave the tire fields out for a wheel-only offset comparison.

current_tire.description: Current tire size. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.

inner_clearance_mm.description: Measured on the current setup: inner sidewall to the nearest suspension or body part.

new_tire.description: New tire size. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.

outer_clearance_mm.description: Measured on the current setup: tire sidewall to fender lip.

name: wheel_fitment_check
title: Will these wheels (and tires) fit
